Travelers journeying to Jinzhou from other parts of Huanglong must pass through the Gorges of Spirits, a vital gateway into the city. }} The '''Gorges of Spirits''' is a region in [[Jinzhou (Province)|Jinzhou]], [[Huanglong]].
